newsitem.title: USA: Canadian spot natgas little changed in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Canadian spot natgas little changed in light trade.

text.p: Canadian spot natgas prices were little changed again Tuesday as an industry gas conference in Toronto kept many traders away from the market.
"The Gas Fair has everyone tied up. There's hardly any activity," one Calgary-based trader said, noting Alberta prices slipped about one cent.
Spot gas at the AECO storage hub in Alberta traded anywhere from C$1.85 to C$1.89 per gigajoule (GJ), with most deals done at C$1.85-1.86, market sources said.
June AECO was also steady to down one cent at C$1.85 per GJ, traders said.
